description: Search USGS's "Critical mineral deposits of the United States" database (ver. 3.0, September 2026) — 1,271 documented deposits across 41 states + Puerto Rico. Filter by commodity (e.g. "lithium", "cobalt", "rare earth elements"), US state/territory abbreviation, and/or a bounding box. Returns each deposit's id, name, state, coordinates, minerals, deposit type, and resource figures. AUTHORITATIVE for "where are US lithium/cobalt/REE deposits" and "which critical mineral deposits are in <state>". Sourced from USGS.

commodity.description: Critical mineral/commodity, e.g. "lithium", "cobalt", "ree", "copper". Matched against the dataset's own commodity vocabulary (not a canonical element list) — an unmatched value returns found:false with the full commodity list.

state.description: US state or territory 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "CA", "AK", "PR".

name: usgs_cmd_deposits_search
title: Usgs Cmd Deposits Search
